content:
Just ahead of its major iPhone announcement event, Apple has just rolled out a new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here's what's in the update.

iOS 26.6.2 fixes a bug that prevented users from updating the software over a cellular connection

Apple is expected to release iOS 27 very soon, possibly as early as next week.

But before that major release, Apple today pushed out a smaller iOS 26.6.2 update.

You can install iOS 26.6.2 by going to Settings -> Software Update.

Here are Apple's official release notes:

Given the fix in this update, it makes sense for iOS 26.6.2 to roll out ahead of the anticipated iOS 27 announcement.

If iOS 26.6.1 had prevented users from installing iOS 27 over cellular, next week could have been a nightmare for both Apple and its users.

But with this update pushed out early, many iPhones will have the necessary fix before installing the highly anticipated iOS 27.

So while this update itself isn't particularly exciting, it comes at just the right time for the impending release of iOS 27 and all its new features.

In addition to iOS 26.6.2, Apple has also released iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad with the same fix.

Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Notice anything else? Drop us a comment below.
